notes.title: Scenery and Gamplay Enhancements
notes.content: The latest update for BlueBete is now live, ushering in a new era for the world ! Prepare to be stunned by a breathtaking visual revolution, as we've upgraded the entire game to Unreal Engine 5.6, delivering hyper-realistic scenery and next-generation fidelity across every landscape. But this evolution is more than skin-deep; your adventure expands with a thrilling new questline, powerful new abilities to master, and challenging endgame content to conquer. All of this is built on a foundation of extensive bug fixes and performance optimizations, ensuring your journey is smoother and more responsive than ever. Log in now and witness the world of BlueBete reborn!

notes.title: Summary of changes
notes.content: Enhanced prompts, scenery update, volumetric clouds, new puzzles in game.

notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.content:
We have updated the hit system to help those struggling to get started and uploaded a video to help as well.

There is still more to be found in the village so keep looking.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bVF1r_0df_E

notes.title: Added more prompts at start of game
notes.content:
Players are not interacting with inventory so more hints needed. The documentation has all the key mappings and can be downloaded here:

http://xaxero.com/Documentation.pdf

The hint stays on the screen until the player starts adding inventory.
